The GPU connects to the CPU via PCIe Gen 4.0 x16 interconnect'. DRAM is not mentioned at all (no type, channels or capacity). The band 4ch DDR5-4800..5200 (TRX50, rated 5200) is reasonably implied by the CPU. Holding the 88 GB model needs >=128 GB, which may mean 2 DIMMs per channel and a lower speed than 4800. Sanity check: CPU-only Mixtral 4.2 tok/s x ~22.5 GB/token (2 experts x 32 layers x 352 MB) is ~95 GB/s, inside the band. 16-bit: Table II 'Model size 88 GB / 79 GB', 'Size per expert 340 MB / 152 MB' for 46.7B / 41.9B params (dtype never named). Misses run on the CPU: Sec III-A 'when a cache miss occurs ... our framework offloads the intermediate state ... to the CPU side for expert computation'. Routing is exact: 'our approach does not require any model modifications'. system_tok_s is text-verified: Sec V 'our framework achieved up to 4.8 and 10.4 tokens/second, respectively, demonstrating significant speedups (up to 4.4x)'. The raw row's 'abstract' quote is not in the arXiv abstract (checked both the abs page and the PDF); it paraphrases the Conclusion. Baselines at OMP_NUM_THREADS=24 were read from the vector Fig. 5 labels (PDF text layer plus a 300 dpi render). Pre-gated is estimated, not run: 'Since Pre-gated MoE implementation does not support these newer models, we estimate its performance by assuming perfect computation-communication overlap'. On-demand fetching (refs [3,8]) is drawn only as a horizontal reference line, so whether it was measured is unclear. All classes 'other engine' correct. No llama.cpp baseline. Mixtral panel at 24 threads: Fiddler 2.7, CPU only 4.2, cache (7,8) 4.8, (8,7) 4.8, (9,6) 4.7, ..., (29,2) 2.2; legend lines 'On-demand Fetching 1.1 tokens/s', 'Pre-gated MoE 1.1 tokens/s'. All row values correct. Budget: Sec III-B 'around 56 expert slots can be accommodated for the Mixtral 8x7B model, which consists of 256 experts in total'. Both 4.8 configs have 56 slots, so 0.21875 is correct; 'Mixtral 8x7B requires approximately 5 GB for them' (non-expert). Minor: the text's 'surpassing Fiddler by approximately 1.6x' does not match 24-thread 4.8/2.7 = 1.8x. Fiddler's best is 3.0 at 16 threads, where ours is 4.2 (1.4x). Speedup 4.8/1.1 = 4.4x vs Pre-gated matches the text.
